tasks.title: A customer-host runner token is team-scoped, revocable and replay-proof
tasks.verifier: registration returns the token once and stores only its sha256 plus a derived attestation key; a signed confinement attestation verifies and its digest matches the stored row; a tampered signature, a confinement mismatch, an unknown key, a replayed nonce and a stale timestamp are each refused; a second team's token lists nothing, and claim/finish/assign/revoke of the first team's ids answer the same 404 as unknown ids; claiming holds the run_claims lease as runner:<id>, a second claim is refused, heartbeat renews, finish deletes only the runner's own claim; an expired lease releases the job and orphans (never re-queues) the run; revocation is idempotent and kills the token on the next request, rotation mints a new token and kills the old one immediately, an anonymous malformed body is 401 not 422; revoked runners take no jobs; every lifecycle action leaves an audit row
tasks.expected: exit 0 and the task's own verdict is PASS (42 checks)
tasks.notes: no model; LIVE 42/42 PASS on the compose stack at 2026-10-29 (w13-runner-1793260362.json): revocation, replay/staleness, signed-attestation verification, cross-team 404 equivalence and the claim/lease/finish lifecycle judged from run_claims. Control plane only: the runner holds and completes a lease but does not yet execute the approved plan (execution leg OPEN, docs/m2-w13-plan.md). The queued run_claims row is seeded directly and the team's cap is saturated first because no BYO dispatch endpoint exists; the second team's session uses the local dev login route

tasks.verifier: fixture leg (no model): 960x640 decode, seven flat colours exact, title text drawn, zero self-diff, deterministic re-render; live leg: agent opens the mockup, measures colour, screenshots, diffs; independent re-render ratio <= 0.03 with colours within 12 and the agent's reported ratio agreeing within 0.005
tasks.expected: fixture leg every check true, then live leg: ratio <= 0.03, all seven flat colours within 12 and the agent's reported ratio within 0.005
tasks.notes: Live PASS on attempt 4/4: ratio 0.004583, all seven flat colours exact, token transcribed, agent's RATIO agreed. Disclosed attempt history: (1) 401 — worker daemon had no provider key; (2) 'Invalid Anthropic Messages API request' — the daemon lacked the OpenRouter vision patch, so the engine spoke the wrong provider; (3) genuine model failure — the model wrote only style.css, probed 47 images and exhausted the 51-call budget with no page (recorded w14-design-1793274472.json; its 'wrote the page' check was spuriously true because the drill treated a blank line as content, fixed before the final run). Thresholds and the goal text were never changed after the first run; repeated attempts are a purity caveat, recorded rather than hidden. This design is not used for tuning.
